items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know who they were a lot of times, but the older musicians said, 'That's so-and-so-and-so, and he's this and he's that.' ... They would say, 'That's Ben Webster'

ctx.x: This is where I met this fellow Toby Walker, who I was saying was my first real contact with a person I thought was a genius. And I actually became acquainted with him, and would go up there every night religiously to listen to him and have him dazzle me with what he was doing. And he liked me very much.

When I'd go up there at night... I would walk in there one night, there would be Duke Ellington, there would be Johnny Hodges or Sonny Greer, people out of Duke's band. Another night it would be guys... At that particular time Ben Webster was with Cab Calloway. There would be people like Ben Webster... Them guys were celebrities. I didn't know who they were a lot of times, but the older musicians said, "That's so-and-so-and-so, and he's this and he's that."
